// <auto-generated />
#nullable enable
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;
using OcctSharp.Interop;
namespace OcctSharp.CopiedCollections;
/// <summary>Immutable row-major grid with explicit native row and column bounds.</summary>
public sealed class CopiedGrid<T> where T : unmanaged
{
    private readonly T[] _values;
    /// <summary>Copies rows of consecutive columns. Dimensions and kernel offset arithmetic must be safe.</summary>
    public CopiedGrid(ReadOnlySpan<T> values, int rows, int columns, int rowLower = 1, int columnLower = 1)
    {
        if (rows <= 0 || columns <= 0 || (long)rows * columns != values.Length) throw new ArgumentException("Grid dimensions do not match data.");
        long count = (long)rows * columns, offset = (long)rowLower * columns, begin = offset + columnLower;
        static bool Safe(long v) => v > int.MinValue && v < int.MaxValue;
        if (rowLower == int.MinValue || columnLower == int.MinValue || (long)rowLower + rows > int.MaxValue
            || (long)columnLower + columns > int.MaxValue || !Safe(offset) || !Safe(count + columnLower) || !Safe(begin) || !Safe(begin + count))
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(rowLower), "Grid bounds exceed safe kernel arithmetic.");
        Rows = rows; Columns = columns; RowLower = rowLower; ColumnLower = columnLower;
        _values = values.ToArray();
    }
    /// <summary>Row count.</summary>
    public int Rows { get; }
    /// <summary>Column count.</summary>
    public int Columns { get; }
    /// <summary>First native row.</summary>
    public int RowLower { get; }
    /// <summary>First native column.</summary>
    public int ColumnLower { get; }
    /// <summary>Last native row.</summary>
    public int RowUpper => checked(RowLower + Rows - 1);
    /// <summary>Last native column.</summary>
    public int ColumnUpper => checked(ColumnLower + Columns - 1);
    /// <summary>Total element count.</summary>
    public int Count => _values.Length;
    /// <summary>Gets an element by native indices, checking each dimension.</summary>
    public T this[int row, int column] {
        get {
            long r = (long)row - RowLower, c = (long)column - ColumnLower;
            if (r < 0 || r >= Rows || c < 0 || c >= Columns) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(row));
            return _values[(int)(r * Columns + c)];
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Returns a fresh row-major copy.</summary>
    public T[] ToArray() => (T[])_values.Clone();
    internal ReadOnlySpan<T> Values => _values;
}
